summary: layered installer dashboard and idempotent setup runner
reads: Python package index / configured pip indexes (external, confirm-gated)
Ollama daemon and model registry (external/local, confirm-gated)
hints: Bare `ops setup` is a read-only layered dashboard. `ops setup <layer>` advances one layer idempotently. `ops setup --wizard` is a guided, interactive first-run: one skippable prompt per layer with safe defaults (skeleton on; search/models/automation off), interactive-only (needs a tty; not with --json/--dry-run — those exit 2 pointing at `ops setup --all --yes` / `ops setup --json`). Search and model layers can install Python packages and pull Ollama models into external stores, so they require `--yes`; backups is a human handoff and is never included in `--all`. `--dry-run` previews any advance (single layer or `--all`) without installing/writing and needs no `--yes`.
